alt: 三名學生熱心栽種幼苗，一名同齡學生卻穿得過分正式，昂首背手指點眾人，擺出自負又暮氣沉沉的姿態。
scene_prompt: Meaning: someone, even young, acts pompously seasoned, puts on airs, and lacks youthful vitality. In a contemporary school gardening club, three lively teenagers plant seedlings and invite a fourth to help. The fourth teenager stands apart in an overly formal cardigan, one hand behind his back and the other pointing critically, chin raised and expression smugly world-weary, lecturing instead of joining; his unused trowel lies clean beside him. He is clearly young, contrasting with the others' energetic teamwork.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, logos, watermarks, brand marks, speech bubbles, or identifiable existing characters. Modern everyday setting. Clear visual storytelling at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural colors; no glossy digital rendering, 3D, flat vector blocks, or imitation of a named artist.
